note: Overhead: InnoMaker 32x32 UVC module on TheRobotStudio overhead post mount, CALIBRATED to the real rig on 2026-11-10 (see cameras.overhead.calibration_status). Wrists: unchanged nominal entries (not calibrated). The CAD-only version is so101_camera_rig.cad.json; the old straight-down Arducam overhead is so101_camera_rig.arducam_nominal.json.

overhead.hardware_model: InnoMaker U20CAM-720P USB 2.0 UVC module (32x32 mm, OV9732, M12 lens, 120 deg DFOV / 102 deg HFOV at 1280x720)
overhead.calibration_status: calibrated 2026-11-10: lens by sim-e5 (fit232), pose+focal by rigfit SAM-mask fit on 4 robot-driven runs (held-out IoU 0.638)
overhead.optics_note: Fitted pinhole + OpenCV radial distortion (k1, k2). The CAD/lens-spec stand-in was fx=fy=417, no distortion, pos (0, -0.1857, 0.5371), tilt 24.8 deg; the fit puts the optical centre ~4 cm higher with a wider field and real barrel distortion. (Fit units converted to the sim's focal-pixel camera on 2026-11-10: f 246.1 at the fitter's assumed render focal -> 610.7 px; k1/k2 rescaled accordingly.)

mount.derivation: STL stack: bottom shoulder 223.25 mm, middle/top offset 188.25 mm; camera plate underside 550.7 mm at the lens hole, tilted 24.8 deg forward (plate normal 0.42,-0.91); optical centre taken 15 mm beyond the plate along the view axis -> 36.3 mm forward of the post axis, 537 mm above the table. Post axis 22.6 mm behind each arm's footprint centre, centred between the arms. Arms sit on the mount's arm_base plates, 232 mm apart (scene.ARM_X).

left_wrist.hardware_model: Arducam 12MP IMX708 USB UVC autofocus camera module (B030401, 75-degree diagonal lens)
left_wrist.calibration_status: calibrated 2026-11-10 by rigfit wrist fit (gripper-jaw SAM masks, held-out IoU 0.823)
left_wrist.optics_note: Arducam B030401: Sony IMX708 (Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3 sensor) on a USB 2.0 UVC adapter, autofocus 10 cm to infinity, 75-degree diagonal lens listed as 61 degrees horizontal and 50 degrees vertical, 32x32 mm board. Nominal pinhole from the 61-degree horizontal figure at 640x480 (vertical then 47.8 degrees). Distortion coefficients are unmeasured zero placeholders; autofocus changes the effective focal length slightly with focus distance, so calibrate each unit at its working focus. Mount poses are nominal.
